O.content: The small state area labeled "DE" is filled orange.
The pale-yellow top of the color bar is adjacent to the inscriptions "High" and "100", while the dark-maroon bottom is adjacent to "Low" and "0".

B.text: For labeled state areas on this choropleth, fill color is the risk-index encoding. The vertical legend maps the pale-yellow top near the inscriptions "High" and "100" to higher risk and the dark-maroon bottom near "Low" and "0" to lower risk. Under this shared legend, a state whose fill is closer in color to the pale-yellow top has higher risk; the task criterion requires opening the available option for the highest-risk listed state.
B.conditions: Applies if the labeled state fills use the displayed continuous legend and the choice is restricted to Illinois, Kansas, and Delaware options.
